pick.headline: Vaclav Havel elected president of Czechoslovakia
pick.summary: On 29 December 1989 the Federal Assembly unanimously elected the dissident playwright Vaclav Havel president of Czechoslovakia.
pick.significance: A man imprisoned by the regime months earlier became head of state; under Havel, Czechoslovakia opened the files of its secret police, the StB.
